confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates, not checked against live menus or booking listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies a lot with July demand in Aarhus. The FX value comes from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct page read. The beer, cocktail and wine anchors come from general knowledge of Danish restaurant pricing, not from a local price relationship.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Nordic and Danish cities such as Odense and Gothenburg, adjusted upward for Denmark's high restaurant and hotel price level and for July peak-season hotel demand in Aarhus.
